tools.name: pss_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers) with contact details, client type and status. Search by name, email or phone. PSS API: GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: pss_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by UUID. PSS API: GET /v1/clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: pss_create_client
tools.description: Create a client (customer). Requires first name and client type. Creates a record in the company's PSS account. PSS API: POST /v1/clients.

tools.name: pss_update_client
tools.description: Change some fields of one client (partial update; only the fields you pass change). PSS API: PATCH /v1/clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: pss_list_members
tools.description: List company members (office staff and technicians) with roles and technician details. PSS API: GET /v1/members.

tools.name: pss_get_member
tools.description: Get one company member by UUID, including roles and technician details. PSS API: GET /v1/members/{memberId}.

tools.name: pss_list_properties
tools.description: List properties (the pools and sites serviced for clients), with address, pool volume and service frequency. PSS API: GET /v1/properties.

tools.name: pss_get_property
tools.description: Get one property by UUID, including pool volume, surface type, tech notes and flags. PSS API: GET /v1/properties/{propertyId}.

tools.name: pss_create_property
tools.description: Create a property (pool or site) for an existing client. Requires client id, property type, address and start date. PSS API: POST /v1/properties.

tools.name: pss_update_property
tools.description: Change some fields of one property (partial update; only the fields you pass change). PSS API: PATCH /v1/properties/{propertyId}.

tools.name: pss_list_routes
tools.description: List service routes: which technician services which property, on which weekday, in which stop order. PSS API: GET /v1/routes.

tools.name: pss_get_route
tools.description: Get one service route by UUID. PSS API: GET /v1/routes/{routeId}.

tools.name: pss_list_job_types
tools.description: List job types (for example repair or chemical service) with their ids. PSS API: GET /v1/jobTypes.

tools.name: pss_get_job_type
tools.description: Get one job type by UUID. PSS API: GET /v1/jobTypes/{jobTypeId}.

tools.name: pss_list_item_types
tools.description: List item types (the categories line items and catalog items belong to). PSS API: GET /v1/itemTypes.

tools.name: pss_get_item_type
tools.description: Get one item type by UUID. PSS API: GET /v1/itemTypes/{itemTypeId}.

tools.name: pss_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders) with status and dates. Filter by client, property, technician, status or start-date range. PSS API: GET /v1/jobs.

tools.name: pss_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by UUID, with totals, notes and its scheduled instances. PSS API: GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: pss_list_job_line_items
tools.description: List the line items (parts, labour, charges) on one job. PSS API: GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/lineItems.

tools.name: pss_create_job
tools.description: Create a job (work order) for a client. Requires client id, subject and duration type (SingleDay or MultipleDay). Optional line items. PSS API: POST /v1/jobs.

tools.name: pss_update_job
tools.description: Change some fields of one job (partial update; only the fields you pass change). PSS API: PATCH /v1/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: pss_schedule_job
tools.description: Put a job on a day's route. stopPreference sets where it goes in the day: optimized, first or last. PSS API: POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}/schedule.

tools.name: pss_unschedule_job
tools.description: Take a job off a day's route. PSS API: POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}/unschedule.

tools.name: pss_reopen_job
tools.description: Reopen a job that is marked done so the team can change it. PSS API: POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}/reopen.

tools.name: pss_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status, amounts and balance. Filter by client, status or issue-date range. PSS API: GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: pss_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by UUID, with its line items and payments. PSS API: GET /v1/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: pss_list_visits
tools.description: List service visits in one list: route visits and completed job visits, sorted by service time. Good for 'what did the team do on this day'. PSS API: GET /v1/visits.

tools.name: pss_get_visit
tools.description: Get one visit by UUID, with pool readings (pH, chlorine and so on), checklist items and chemical dosages. PSS API: GET /v1/visits/{visitId}.

tools.name: pss_list_catalog_items
tools.description: List catalog items (the company's price list of parts and services) with rate and stock. PSS API: GET /v1/catalog.

tools.name: pss_get_catalog_item
tools.description: Get one catalog item by UUID. PSS API: GET /v1/catalog/{catalogId}.

tools.name: pss_create_catalog_item
tools.description: Add an item to the company's price list. Requires item type id, name, quantity and rate. PSS API: POST /v1/catalog.

tools.name: pss_update_catalog_item
tools.description: Change some fields of one catalog item (partial update; only the fields you pass change). PSS API: PATCH /v1/catalog/{catalogId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pss_list_clients, pss_list_invoices, pss_create_catalog_item · Private data: pss_list_clients, pss_create_client · Public sink: pss_list_clients, pss_create_client, pss_create_property, pss_create_job, pss_schedule_job, pss_unschedule_job, pss_reopen_job, pss_create_catalog_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pss_list_clients, pss_list_invoices, pss_create_catalog_item · Private data: pss_list_clients, pss_create_client · Public sink: pss_list_clients, pss_create_client, pss_create_property, pss_create_job, pss_schedule_job, pss_unschedule_job, pss_reopen_job, pss_create_catalog_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
